title: Fix Elements Scene Dev
description: Fix elements scene dev server: 504 Outdated Optimize Dep and failed dynamic import of index.tsx on port 6013.
summary: Fixed elements scene dev 504 Outdated Optimize Dep by deduping Three.js to @elements/ui's 0.182 build (was split across root 0.180 and core 0.182), adding optimizeDeps prebundle for R3F stack, mapping three/addons to examples/jsm, clearing stale .vite cache on dev start, aligning scene three dep to ^0.182.0, and fixing vitest expectations for log-LOD and WindowBodyViewContext.
